planets.name: B
planets.note: Low-mass companion at semimajor axis ~18.6 au, spectral type M3-M7 (Teff~3200K, log g=5.5); dynamical mass estimate is prior-dependent: 31(+35/-11) M_Jup with a log-normal mass prior, or 128(+127/-88) M_Jup with a Gaussian prior. Host HIP 5319 A is an accelerating F5 star (Hipparcos-Gaia astrometric anomaly) shown by this paper to be a single star, not the spectroscopic binary previously reported.

paper.title: SCExAO and Keck Direct Imaging Discovery of a Low-Mass Companion Around the Accelerating F5 Star HIP 5319
